nodes.name: Manual Trigger (webhook)
nodes.notes: Para demos y pruebas: POST /webhook/pay-run con la cabecera x-pay-token. El cuerpo puede traer "now" (solo en modo mock).

nodes.name: Prepare
nodes.notes: El reloj es la hora real; "now" solo se acepta con el token y en modo mock.

parameters.query:
SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('invoice_id', i.invoice_id, 'contact_email', i.contact_email, 'customer_name', i.customer_name, 'timezone', i.timezone,
    'amount', i.amount, 'paid_total', i.paid_total, 'currency', i.currency, 'due_date', i.due_date::text, 'status', i.status, 'paused_until', i.paused_until, 'promise_count', i.promise_count,
    'suppressed', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM suppression_list s WHERE s.key = lower(i.contact_email)),
    'sent_stages', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(r.stage) FROM pay_reminders r WHERE r.invoice_id = i.invoice_id AND r.status IN ('sent', 'escalated')), '[]'::jsonb)) ORDER BY i.due_date, i.invoice_id), '[]'::jsonb) AS rows
FROM pay_invoices i WHERE i.status = 'open'

nodes.name: Read Invoices
nodes.notes: Facturas abiertas con su saldo (importe − pagado), bajas y etapas ya enviadas. Se lee en la misma corrida que envía, segundos antes.

nodes.name: Plan Reminders
nodes.notes: DETERMINÍSTICO: solo facturas abiertas con saldo, sin pausa ni baja, dentro del horario del cliente. Se envía la etapa que toca (las atrasadas no se acumulan) y un solo mensaje por contacto. La etapa final no escribe al cliente: avisa a una persona.

nodes.name: Send Message
nodes.notes: Mailpit en local (en live: SMS / WhatsApp o el correo de facturación). Un envío fallido NO se registra: se reintenta en la siguiente corrida.

nodes.name: Collect Sends
nodes.notes: Cada etapa cuenta solo si el correo salió.

parameters.query:
WITH d AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS j),
r AS (INSERT INTO pay_reminders (invoice_id, stage, status, sent_at) SELECT x->>'invoice_id', x->>'stage', x->>'status', (d.j->>'now')::timestamptz FROM d, jsonb_array_elements(d.j->'reminders') x
      ON CONFLICT (invoice_id, stage) DO NOTHING RETURNING invoice_id, stage, status),
e AS (INSERT INTO pay_events (invoice_id, event, actor, detail) SELECT invoice_id, CASE status WHEN 'sent' THEN 'reminder_sent' WHEN 'escalated' THEN 'escalated_to_person' ELSE 'stage_superseded' END, 'system', jsonb_build_object('stage', stage) FROM r RETURNING id)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM r WHERE status = 'sent') AS sent, (SELECT count(*) FROM r WHERE status = 'escalated') AS escalated, (SELECT count(*) FROM r WHERE status = 'superseded') AS superseded

nodes.name: Record Reminders
nodes.notes: Registra las etapas enviadas, las saltadas (superseded) y los avisos a persona. Una etapa por factura: nunca se repite.

nodes.name: Assert Run
nodes.notes: Falla ruidosamente DESPUÉS de registrar lo que sí se envió → Error Handler.

parameters.content:
## Payments · Daily Reminders
Every day: reads the open invoices with their balance, and code decides who is due: upcoming, due, 7 and 14 days overdue (one message per customer, the latest stage only). At 30 days it writes to a person, not to the customer. Paid, disputed, paused and opted-out invoices are skipped, and a stage counts as sent only after the email went out.
